scope: All 63 PCRs separately assessed against all twelve user principles, from the current four-file records and freshly checked evidence. Prior review conclusions are not used as pass certificates. Each criterion has an answer, current facts, disposition and source anchors; unresolved verification is not relabeled passed.
conclusion: One additional material applicability ambiguity in 54740 repaired. Four PCRs retain specifically identified source-confirmation gaps; all 63 reference product identities remain explicitly unresolved. This is 756 assessments, not 756 unconditional passes or proof all principle errors are exhausted.

findings.severity: material applicability ambiguity, not an observed site-result error
findings.before: event_release used concentration * exhaust_volume * unit_conversion or direct measured net mass for species/medium events. Five protocols supplied generic concentration/exhaust volume without full environmental source/event coverage, representative/background basis, matched gas state or explicit non-air restriction.
findings.counterexample: A room/worker concentration and local sampler or incompletely covered exhaust volume can produce sample/partial-source mass, not total event release. An air-exhaust carrier volume also cannot be used indiscriminately for a different actual receiving medium. These are admissibility counterexamples, not measured errors at a real site.
findings.after: Require independently supported whole-event released mass or, only for an actual air source, representative background-corrected concentration integrated with full source flow/time on matched units/gas state. A concentration-times-volume form requires exactly that event/interval coverage. Other media need total mass or a validated medium-specific method and original operands. Sampling/exposure alone cannot establish total; no duplicate capture correction or unknown-as-zero.

source_locator.limit: Boiler example supports sample-versus-source-rate distinction only. No installation factor, numerical default or non-air method adopted.

processes.role: Inspect the released base and project design before recording entry. Reconcile delivery tickets, SKU/state weighing, rejection and storage inspection. processes.name: Prepare factory dry cementitious masonry mortar
processes.inclusion_condition: Actual scope route; conditional exchanges only when actual evidence establishes occurrence
processes.role: At every actual batch record exact dry premix ID, weighed received internal feed, actual supplied water, mixing operation and product instructions. Weigh wet dispatch and match laying receipt. Measure discarded mortar, wash liquid, packaging and usable exits separately. Characterize solids and water before setting; record reaction state changes, not an invented mix recipe or retarder time.
processes.quantitative_reference: same final A; internal handoffs retain actual quantities

processes.name: Lay, cut, restrain and finish brickwork joints
processes.inclusion_condition: Actual scope route; conditional exchanges only when actual evidence establishes occurrence
processes.role: At each panel/pass match actual brick, wet mortar, designed ancillary and packaging receipts. Record physical base interface release, geometry, cutting method, tooling, restraint and closure installation, water, waste and releases. Preserve cut/offcut and rejected assembly dispositions and all remedial events. Dispatch the actual uncured wall area with its constituent/water state to acceptance; no extra material purchase is created. Existing interface observation roles physical_interface_construction_feed preserve actual geometry/state and release/receipt responsibility, not product inventory.
